topic: Advanced Use of Regular Expressions for File Extension Matching in C++
explanation: This concept demonstrates leveraging C++'s regex library to perform sophisticated pattern matching on file extensions, which is essential for advanced file handling, filtering, or parsing tasks in C/C++ programs. It showcases the use of complex regular expressions with case-insensitive matching to accurately identify source code files based on their extensions, highlighting the integration of modern C++ features for advanced string processing and pattern recognition.
